problem.description: Owner accepts 12 voice profiles but rejects perceptual karaoke sync and several emotion sounds in the 32-second PoC video.
symptoms: Karaoke appears faster than speech after an expression
Throat clearing and unusual styles sound wrong

scope: Investigate and revise isolated PoC; retain accepted voice bank; only laughter, sigh and anger in the next listening round; no shipping source or installed application change.

hypotheses.evidence: Installed caption helper preserves all word times in 6 lines x 2 variants; composition uses frame/fps directly.

hypotheses.description: Video audio is delayed/stretched relative to PCM mix
hypotheses.evidence: Old MP4 audio has constant 42.75ms lag in six windows, not growing drift. Remux from PCM removes measured lag; this is only a confirmed component, not full explanation of owner perception.

hypotheses.description: Wildcard event alignment swallows or misaligns speech
hypotheses.evidence: Greedy CTC matches the tested post-cue word onsets closely, but shares the acoustic model and cannot certify perceptual sync or rule out other failures.

tests_run.output: Six old MP4 windows each lag source PCM by 42.75ms; four independent-from-transcript greedy CTC decodes saved in audit.json.
tests_run.conclusion: supports a constant audio mux delay, not cumulative drift

tests_run.output: 6 lines x 2 variants preserve supplied token timestamps.

16 MP3s / 244 words; 8 reused laugh/sigh clips byte-identical; 8 anger/control CTC text agreements; both revised MP4s measure 0ms audio shift in all six windows at 0.25ms resolution; no browser errors; ZIP CRC passes.
tests_run.conclusion: technical revision checks passed; owner perceptual acceptance pending

findings: Prior structural checks did not establish perceptual synchronization.
Turbo source ignores CFG/exaggeration controls; angry token existence alone does not establish controllable quality.
Owner accepts the 12-profile bank at audition level; retain it.
Only laugh/sigh acoustic events and angry speaking style remain in the new trial. Anger is not sent through the event wildcard.
Two R2 videos compare audio-time words versus intentionally 120ms delayed words; no new product default chosen.

resolution.root_cause: Confirmed constant audio mux delay in prior MP4; full cause of perceived post-expression lead remains unconfirmed.
resolution.fix_applied: Isolated PoC remux from exact source PCM plus explicit 0ms/120ms visual calibration variants; no shipping fix applied.
resolution.verification: Technical checks in data/exports/chatterbox-karaoke-r2-20261024/verification.json. Actual MP4 frames visually inspected. Waiting for owner to hear/watch revised sync and angry style.
resolution.owner_disposition: Chatterbox/emotion integration abandoned by owner; Phase77 plain Edge restoration installed. No further expressive-TTS work active.

owner_decision: B video preferable, but male sighs may sound like another voice/animal growl and female emotion unclear; restore Edge and remove script emotion insertion entirely.
